senses.en: to chop, to hew, to hack
to dig through earth (as an earthworm)
to try to reach above by hand
to ascend, to climb up (mountains, trees, slopes, etc.)
to spear, to pierce with a spear

notes: 原書 banches，疑為 branches 之誤，照抄不改

senses.en: to dig (earth), to dig with a hoe, to dig the ground with a hoe
to look from a high place
